leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a pointer variable to track unique elements in a sorted array
Implement a loop to iterate through array elements while comparing adjacent values
Manipulate array indices to overwrite duplicate elements in-place
Construct a function that returns the count of unique elements after removal
Apply the two-pointer technique to optimize array traversal
Configure test cases to verify the algorithm handles edge cases correctly
Integrate the duplicate removal logic into a complete working solution
